summary: Iteration 27 (Activity Log + Photo→Story) end-to-end verified. All backend endpoints and frontend flows pass. 5 pytests pass (4 new in test_iteration27_full.py + existing test_iteration27_activity.py). Frontend UI flows verified via Playwright: cancel button on companion activity works, photo→story full upload/compose/archive flow works.

backend.activity_feed_redaction: type_text summary = 'N characters' (secret text NOT leaked); clipboard_set = 'copied text to clipboard'; open_url summary = clipped URL
backend.cancel_lifecycle: Queued → cancel returns 200/status='cancelled'; second cancel → 409; non-existent → 404; device POST /result on cancelled cmd_id is ignored (row remains 'cancelled')
backend.photo_story_start: 200 with photo_story_id, description, 3 questions, image_url. Vision (Claude sonnet-4-6) responded in ~10s
backend.photo_story_image: 200 with JPEG bytes (magic FF D8 FF), correct content-type
backend.photo_story_compose: 200 with entry_id, title, content ~200 words. New entry appears in /api/archive with type='story', source='photo_story'

frontend.activity_rows_and_icons: activity-<cmd_id> rows render with kind icons ('Opened a website', 'Typed text', 'Set the clipboard', etc.), status pills, relative time ('just now', '2 ago')
frontend.redaction_visible_in_ui: 'Typed text · 27 characters' shown (no raw text leak)
frontend.stop_button_click: clicked activity-cancel-<cmd_id>, row updated to 'cancelled' within ~2s, Stop button removed
frontend.auto_refresh: Verified pytest-queued commands appear in UI feed (~5s poll working)
frontend.upload_to_questions: Uploaded synthetic JPEG with real features (house/sun/tree), analyzing state → photo-questions view with 3 photo-answer-{0,1,2} textareas + preview
frontend.compose_to_result: photo-compose → photo-story-result rendered with title 'The Summer We Planted the Maple', full first-person memory, 'SAVED TO YOUR ARCHIVE' badge
frontend.post_result_actions: photo-another present; photo-view-archive present with href=/dashboard

critical_code_review_comments: photo_story.py stores full base64 image inside the db.photo_stories doc. That's fine for MVP but will bloat the collection quickly — consider GridFS or object storage if usage grows.
photo_story.py compose endpoint has no length/rate limit on answers array — a giant answers list could inflate the LLM prompt. Consider capping len(payload.answers) and per-answer length.

companion.py activity summary redaction is only applied to type_text and clipboard_set. 'say', 'notify', and 'shell' still surface raw text; that's intentional per current UX but worth confirming it's the desired privacy posture.
companion.py file is 1914 lines — well past the recommended 700-line ceiling; suggest splitting device/command/activity/audio routes into separate modules for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, both flows E2E verified)
